# Narration: gatekeep-pr multi-PR set `12 15 18`, from the returned report batch through dispatch of the next batch ## 0. Fixed context - **Admission.** Admission already passed for three distinct PRs in acme/widgets, which matches origin. - Three PRs is at or below `parallel.maxTasks` 8. - The harness is pi. - There is no positional issue reference and no `--rebase`. - **Parent tracker.** The tasks were initialized at dispatch and are all `in_progress`: - `pr-12 state: /tmp/state-12` - `pr-15 state: /tmp/state-15` - `pr-18 state: /tmp/state-18` - Child trackers were session-local to each child and are not parent tasks. - **Assessed SHAs.** - PR18: verification and review were bound to its gathered, HEAD-verified `headRefOid`, because there was no sync. - PR12: no SHA was assessed. The child timed out. - PR15: no SHA was assessed. It failed before Verify. - **Sync line.** None renders anywhere, because `--rebase` was not passed. ## 1. Result classification All three children were awaited before anything was rendered. | PR | Returned | Parent classification | |---|---|---| | 12 | timeout, no closing line | `failed - helper timeout after 600s` (the first error line, no invented success) | | 15 | `FAILED - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b` | `failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b` | | 18 | `REPORT /tmp/report-18` | report; evidence `ci`, 0 open blockers | Each failure is isolated, and the siblings are unaffected. ## 2. Retry-safety reads (read-only, before rendering the failed menus) For PR12 and PR15, the parent ran these reads: - `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-12 rev-parse --absolute-git-dir`, because a worktree's `.git` is a file. - `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-12 status --porcelain`, which returned empty. - A test for `rebase-merge` and `rebase-apply` under the resolved gitdir. Neither exists. - The same three reads for `/tmp/widgets-pr-15`, all clean. Since no rebase was requested and recovery is clean, `retry` is offered and recommended on both failed menus. ## 3. Summary turn: first PR menu only ``` gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary recommended=1 #12 failed - helper timeout after 600s | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown #15 failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown #18 Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match | evidence: ci | blockers: 0 Shared files: none #12 Verdict: failed - helper timeout after 600s Pick one: 1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record [recommended] 2. stop - remove the gate's checkout if it is safe, then retire #12. Type a number; show evidence prints the full record. ``` The human picks `1`, so `#12 retry` is recorded as a queued pick. Nothing is written. ## 4. PR15 menu turn ``` gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary recommended=1 #15 Verdict: failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b Pick one: 1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record [recommended] 2. stop - remove the gate's checkout if it is safe, then retire #15. Type a number; show evidence prints the full record. ``` The human picks `2`, so `#15 stop` is recorded as a queued, parent-owned pick. ## 5. PR18 report and final menu turn The report is printed verbatim. Its off-contract `Delivers` header and verdict wording are not corrected, and no `Evidence:` line is inserted. ``` gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=2 #18 Delivers The encoder accepts empty input. Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match Pick one: 1. merge - squash-merge #18 at the assessed head. 2. approve - approve this other author's PR at the assessed head. [recommended] 3. reply - post the drafted reply from the record. 4. stop - end the gate and leave the PR and checkout as found. Type a number; show evidence prints the full record (source: ci, assessed head, 0 blockers). ``` The human picks `3`, so `#18 reply` is recorded as a queued pick. ## 6. Executing the queued picks (all picks collected) ``` Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry, #15 stop, #18 reply) Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry, #15 stop, #18 reply) Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry, #15 stop, #18 reply) ``` **#15 stop (parent).** No child is live on PR15's tree, so the parent applies `cleanup.md` `## Non-final stop`: 1. There is no `rebased locally` reset. 2. `/tmp/widgets-pr-15` is not the primary `/tmp/widgets`. 3. The tracked-clean check passes, because porcelain is empty. 4. `merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD ` passes, because there was no wave and HEAD was verified. 5. No keyed contract is recorded, and `worktree.destroy` is null. 6. The parent runs `git -C /tmp/widgets worktree remove --force /tmp/widgets-pr-15`, then `git -C /tmp/widgets worktree prune`. This prints `worktree: done`. 7. There is no branch deletion, base pull, or `## cleanup` override. 8. Teardown deletes `/tmp/state-15` and PR15's helper and log files. There are none, because it failed before Verify. 9. PR15 is retired. Its tracker task `pr-15` is marked `failed` as an unretried failure. **#12 retry and #18 reply.** These are dispatched as one foreground batch. No sibling consent is borrowed, and there are no overlapping batches. Each task uses: - `subagent` with `agent: "pr-gatekeeper"`, `context: "fresh"`, and `async: false` - `skill: "gatekeep-pr"` - `acceptance: { level: "none", reason: "the gatekeep child result line is the handoff contract" }` | Task | cwd | Task carries | |---|---|---| | PR12 `report` | /tmp/widgets-pr-12 |
  • `acme/widgets#12` and its `headRefOid`
  • no rebase; confirmation `not asked`; no answer
  • record `/tmp/state-12` (retained); report `/tmp/report-12`
  • `procedure root: /tmp/procedures/gatekeep-pr`
  • `worktree provisioned at /tmp/widgets-pr-12 on ; fetch and gitignore done - skip the fetch, run no worktree add, verify HEAD`
  • steps 1-5 with fresh Verify, then fresh Review, sequentially, in the same worktree
  • preserve course, `repair.rounds_cap` 6, `repair.syncs_cap` 6, and zero usage; never re-initialize them
| | PR18 `execute` | /tmp/widgets-pr-18 |
  • `acme/widgets#18` and its `headRefOid`
  • queued pick `reply`
  • record `/tmp/state-18`; report `/tmp/report-18`
  • the same procedure root and provisioning statement
  • refresh first: if HEAD moved or the reply row is gone, return a fresh report instead of acting
  • otherwise post the drafted reply already in the record after the output done-check
  • caps and usage stay PR-local
| Both tasks end on exactly one closing result line. Their outputs are not invented here. The parent awaits both before re-rendering the next summary for #12 and #18. ## 7. How the separate snapshots change retry **Unsafe PR12, dirty tree.** If the read shows ` M src/a.ts`: - The retry row is omitted with `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase: M src/a.ts)`. - `stop` becomes the sole and recommended row. - A stop keeps the tree, printing `worktree: kept - uncommitted changes at /tmp/widgets-pr-12`. **Unsafe PR12, mid-rebase.** If `rebase-merge` is present: - The row is omitted with `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase: rebase-merge)`. - `stop` is recommended. - The parent never runs `rebase --abort` on a rebase it did not start, and never retries an unsafe checkout. **PR21, provisioning failure.** PR21 sits at `failed - provisioning - foreign branch at default path` with no child, and the parent never repurposes the foreign tree. - A retry re-provisions only after the human clears the obstacle. - Re-provisioning then runs serially in roster order. It observes the expected branch, a clean tree, and a fast-forward-only sync, and verifies HEAD==`headRefOid`. - PR21 then joins the mixed next batch as a `report` task with the original `/tmp/state-21` and `/tmp/report-21`. Course, caps, and usage are not reset.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary recommended=1

This is a narration of simulated requests. No tools run.

## 1. Handle the returned batch

I await the whole foreground batch before handling picks or running consequences. I classify the results in roster order:

- PR12 becomes `failed - helper timeout after 600s`. Its missing closing result line is not a successful handoff.
- PR15 becomes `failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b`. It failed before Verify.
- PR18 becomes `report`, using `/tmp/report-18` verbatim.

The parent tracker uses `pr-12 state: /tmp/state-12`, `pr-15 state: /tmp/state-15`, and `pr-18 state: /tmp/state-18`. These are roster tasks, not single-PR assessment stages. I retain the existing records and tracking rather than initializing them again. The failed children remain failed until an authorized retry; PR15 becomes complete on retirement.

The original child assessments use the single-PR stage sequence `gather`, `provision`, and `verify`, with `review` and `report` added only as they start. There is no `sync` stage because no rebase was requested. PR15 never starts Verify; PR18 completes fresh Verify followed by fresh Review.

PR18's verification and brief assess exactly the `headRefOid` retained in `/tmp/state-18`. The snapshot supplies no literal SHA, so I do not invent one. PR12 has no accepted verification result, and PR15 has none.

I preserve all three records' PR-local courses, caps of 6, usage counters, deadlines, and checkpoints.

## 2. Check safe retry for PR12

Before offering retry, I request these read-only commands:

```sh
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-12 status --porcelain
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-12 rev-parse --absolute-git-dir
```

Using the actual gitdir returned by Git, I check for both operation directories:

```sh
test -d <actual-gitdir>/rebase-merge
test -d <actual-gitdir>/rebase-apply
```

The supplied snapshot establishes empty porcelain output and neither directory present. Retry is available.

## 3. Render the summary and PR12 menu

The parent renders the summary once. It does not insert a report for either failed child.

```text
#12 failed - helper timeout after 600s | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#15 failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#18 Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match | evidence: ci | blockers: 0

Shared files:
none

#12

Pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record. [recommended]
2. stop - end this PR's gate and remove its checkout if safe.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
```

The human selects **1**. I queue `retry12`; I do not dispatch it yet.

## 4. Check PR15 and render its menu in the next turn

I request:

```sh
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 status --porcelain
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 rev-parse --absolute-git-dir
test -d <actual-gitdir>/rebase-merge
test -d <actual-gitdir>/rebase-apply
```

Its supplied safe-retry snapshot is also clean and outside a rebase. The next simulated turn is:

```text
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary recommended=1

#15

Pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record. [recommended]
2. stop - end this PR's gate and remove its checkout if safe.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
```

The human selects **2**. I queue `stop15`; I do not remove its worktree yet.

## 5. Render PR18's report and menu in the next turn

I read `/tmp/report-18` and print its contents verbatim. I do not repair its headings, verdict, or missing evidence line.

```text
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary recommended=2

#18

Delivers
The encoder accepts empty input.
Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match

Pick one:
1. merge - merge the assessed head under the resolved merge policy.
2. approve - approve the assessed head. [recommended]
3. reply - post the drafted review-thread replies.
4. stop - end the gate and leave the checkout as found.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
```

No `Sync:` line renders for any PR because no rebase was requested. PR18's verdict remains exactly:

```text
Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match
```

The human selects **3**. I queue `reply18`. This authorizes the retained drafted replies, not approval, merge, or delivery.

## 6. Execute the parent-owned stop after collection

All picks are now collected, and no child remains live. Before the stop execution block, I print:

```text
Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry; #15 stop; #18 reply)
```

PR15's stop is parent-owned and excluded from the next child batch. It is a non-final stop, so I request the non-final cleanup checks:

```sh
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 rev-parse --git-common-dir
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD <last-pushed-head-from-state-15>
```

I apply the retained trusted worktree ownership and destroy configuration. These checks are fresh; the earlier retry check does not substitute for them.

For an eligible checkout, I request its recorded destroy command from `/tmp/widgets`, or, when no destroy command is recorded:

```sh
git -C /tmp/widgets worktree remove --force /tmp/widgets-pr-15
```

After successful destruction, I request:

```sh
git -C /tmp/widgets worktree prune
```

An unsafe checkout is kept with its concrete reason. Unpushed commits are not discarded; discarding them requires a separate explicit decision.

I run no branch deletion, base pull, or cleanup override. I delete only PR15's retained record and associated temporary helper, log, and body files under teardown, then retire PR15. I do not touch PR12's or PR18's evidence.

## 7. Request the mixed next batch

I dispatch one fresh foreground batch, with two tasks and no PR15 task:

```text
subagent({
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  tasks: [
    {
      agent: "pr-gatekeeper",
      cwd: "/tmp/widgets-pr-12",
      skill: "gatekeep-pr",
      acceptance: {
        level: "none",
        reason: "the gatekeep child result line is the handoff contract"
      },
      task: <PR12 report duty>
    },
    {
      agent: "pr-gatekeeper",
      cwd: "/tmp/widgets-pr-18",
      skill: "gatekeep-pr",
      acceptance: {
        level: "none",
        reason: "the gatekeep child result line is the handoff contract"
      },
      task: <PR18 execute duty>
    }
  ]
})
```

Both task texts explicitly carry the injected skill and batch contract, plus:

- `procedure root: /tmp/procedures/gatekeep-pr`.
- The PR identity, exact retained assessed head, no rebase, and `rebase confirmation: not asked`.
- The existing record and report paths; no second record or report may be minted.
- `worktree provisioned at <path> on <retained headRefOid>; fetch and gitignore done - skip the fetch, run no worktree add, verify HEAD`.
- Instructions to validate the existing identity and record, retain PR-local authority and accounting, and resolve procedure dependencies relative to the installed procedure root.
- The batch recovery adapter and exact closing-result-line contract.

**PR12's task** uses mode `report`, `/tmp/state-12`, and `/tmp/report-12`. It reassesses through steps 1-5 using the same record. It dispatches fresh Verify and then fresh Review sequentially in `/tmp/widgets-pr-12`, with separate OS-temp helper outputs. Verify is report-only and follows Section B's evidence resolution; Review follows Section C and the trusted merged rubric. Neither helper receives repair authority.

**PR18's task** uses mode `execute`, `/tmp/state-18`, `/tmp/report-18`, and queued pick `reply`. It refreshes head, body, base, state, and availability before writing. A moved head or unavailable row returns a fresh report instead of executing the stale pick. Otherwise, it validates and posts only the retained replyable drafts after the output done-check and external-write checks, recording successful posted comment identities. It receives no delivery course and no authority to approve or merge.

I await both tasks. I do not invent their output or render another menu.

## Separate safety and provisioning snapshots

These do not replace any first-batch result.

- With PR12 porcelain output ` M src/a.ts`, retry is omitted and the menu states `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase:  M src/a.ts)`. Stop is last and recommended.
- With `rebase-merge` present in PR12's actual gitdir, retry is omitted and the reason names `rebase-merge`. I do not dispatch a retry or treat stop as authority to discard unsafe work.
- PR21's initial foreign-branch provisioning failure has no child dispatch. After the human clears that obstacle and selects retry, I re-provision only PR21 using the unchanged provisioning rules: reuse the expected branch, require a clean tree and no foreign operation, fast-forward only, and verify `HEAD == headRefOid`. Once those checks succeed, its task enters mode `report` with the original `/tmp/state-21` and `/tmp/report-21`; it does not reset counters, caps, or authority.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly: the summary turn carries only #12's menu, each pick is collected before the next PR's report and menu renders, and every fact Before kept still holds (classification, unknown evidence rows, hint-only show evidence, mixed batch composition, Not offered wording, PR21 re-provisioning). Nothing moved, but a few wording drifts are worth tightening so later facts don't slip: (1) the PR12 task now says the record is 'retained' where Before said 'validated, never reinitialized' - keep the word 'validated' so the record-validation step stays explicit; (2) the PR18 turn is tagged gate=gatekeep-pr/final instead of batch-summary, which makes the three per-PR turns look like different gates - keep one gate tag for the whole summary round; (3) the 'Queued until all picks are collected' line is printed three times in a block after all picks are already in - print it once per queued pick at the moment it is queued (i.e. right after each turn's pick), which is also the natural place for it under the new one-PR-per-turn flow; (4) Before deliberately omitted a single recommended= token because each menu carries its own [recommended], whereas After now emits recommended=1/recommended=2 per turn - this is fine under per-turn rendering but should be stated as a consequence of the Change rather than left implicit.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: No fact moved. After delivers the Change cleanly: the summary is printed once with PR12's menu attached, PR15's safety check and menu are rendered in a separate simulated turn only after the PR12 pick, and PR18's verbatim report and menu follow only after the PR15 pick, with a single 'Queued until all picks are collected' line before the stop. All six facts survive: PR12/PR15 keep their distinct failure strings with unknown evidence/blockers and retry/stop rows (show evidence hint-only), PR18 reaches its unchanged merge/approve/reply/stop menu, the next batch has report-mode retry12 and execute reply18 on original paths with no PR15 child, the retry text retains the record and PR-local authority, the dirty/mid-rebase probes print the exact 'Not offered: retry (...)' wording, and PR21 re-provisions only after the obstacle clears with the original state/report paths. Two small things worth tightening in After without affecting the Change: (1) state explicitly that the PR21 provisioning failure does not abort or re-roster siblings (Before only implied this too, but 'only PR21' is doing that work now), and (2) After dropped the explicit sentence that no sibling record's authority is borrowed on retry—'retain PR-local authority and accounting' still covers f4, but restoring 'no sibling authority is borrowed' would make it unambiguous. Consider also keeping a one-line per-PR failure echo above each failed menu as Before did, so each turn is self-contained once the summary has scrolled away.
